title: Authorization bypass through user-controlled key in GUI

vulnerabilities.product: Authorization bypass through user-controlled key in GUI

notes.title: Additional info
notes.text:
The vulnerability impacts the JSON API if enabled (Disabled by default)
If enabled on a profile, it can be disabled it via the following configuration:

config system admin profile
  edit <profile name>
    set rpc-permit none
end

remediations.details:
FortiSASE-Sovereign 26.2: Fortinet remediated this issue in 26.2 (not released) and hence customers do not need to perform any action.
FortiSASE-Sovereign 25.4: Migrate to a fixed release
FortiSASE-Sovereign 25.3: Migrate to a fixed release
FortiSASE-Sovereign 25: Migrate to a fixed release
